shared_elements: incised linear motifs on a flat slab face
row(s) of small repeated sign-like marks along the upper area
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow incised linear work on a slab face with what reads as a band of small sign-like marks across the upper zone and a cross-shaped element in the field below, which is the most specific correspondence. However, B's content is a clearly organised epigraphic panel over a single large, symmetrical foliate cross with scrolled terminals, while A appears to show irregular figural/architectural shapes without any comparable ornamental cross scheme or symmetry.
